guideVideoOutfits.title: How to find outfits from videos
guideVideoOutfits.subtitle: A practical workflow to go from a TikTok or Reel to shoppable pieces.
guideVideoOutfits.intro: Video outfits move fast. Lighting changes, fabrics blur, and multiple items compete for attention. The trick is to slow things down and search with intention. Use this playbook to get cleaner matches and better alternatives.
guideVideoOutfits.supportNote: Works best with public videos from TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and Facebook.
guideVideoOutfits.tldrItems.item1: Pause on a crisp frame with the full item visible.
guideVideoOutfits.tldrItems.item2: Search one piece at a time and crop tight.
guideVideoOutfits.tldrItems.item3: Describe the item with fabric, fit, and color.
guideVideoOutfits.tldrItems.item4: Compare results, then refine with a new frame if needed.
guideVideoOutfits.section1.title: 1) Capture the cleanest frame
guideVideoOutfits.section1.body: The better the frame, the better the match. Aim for a moment where the item is fully visible, well lit, and not in motion.
guideVideoOutfits.section1.items.item1: Look for a front or 3/4 angle instead of side-on.
guideVideoOutfits.section1.items.item2: Avoid frames with heavy motion blur or compression artifacts.
guideVideoOutfits.section1.items.item3: If the creator pans quickly, pause one beat earlier than you think.
guideVideoOutfits.section2.title: 2) Isolate one item per search
guideVideoOutfits.section2.body: Outfits are layered. Focus on a single item and keep the crop tight around it.
guideVideoOutfits.section2.items.item1: Start with the statement piece (jacket, shoes, bag).
guideVideoOutfits.section2.items.item2: Run separate searches for top, bottom, and accessories.
guideVideoOutfits.section2.items.item3: Leave a small margin so the full silhouette is visible.
guideVideoOutfits.section3.title: 3) Add smart context in the description
guideVideoOutfits.section3.body: Your description helps the model prioritize the right category and materials.
guideVideoOutfits.section3.items.item1: Call out fabric and texture: denim, tweed, leather, ribbed knit.
guideVideoOutfits.section3.items.item2: Mention distinctive details: double-breasted, square toe, gold hardware.
guideVideoOutfits.section3.items.item3: Add branding cues if visible: logo placement, stripe colors, monogram.
guideVideoOutfits.section4.title: 4) Validate, then refine
guideVideoOutfits.section4.body: Use the first results as a compass. If the match is close but off, tweak your input and try again.
guideVideoOutfits.section4.items.item1: Compare neckline, seams, and hardware against retailer photos.
guideVideoOutfits.section4.items.item2: Try synonyms: trench vs coat, sneakers vs trainers.
guideVideoOutfits.section4.items.item3: Re-run with a new frame if the color or pattern looks off.
guideVideoOutfits.section5.title: 5) Save your wins and set alerts
guideVideoOutfits.section5.body: When you find the right item, save it. Prices move fast, so alerts help you buy at the right time.
guideVideoOutfits.section5.items.item1: Save multiple retailers for the same piece.
guideVideoOutfits.section5.items.item2: Track sale colors or sizes before they sell out.
guideVideoOutfits.section5.items.item3: Keep a shortlist for seasonal drops.
guideVideoOutfits.outroTitle: Try the workflow on your next video
guideVideoOutfits.outroBody: Paste a link and Spot This Fit will break down the outfit for you.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Your privacy matters to us. This policy explains what information Spot This Fit collects, how we use it, and your rights regarding your data.
privacy.collectBody: We collect the following information when you use Spot This Fit: images you upload for product identification, video URLs you submit for analysis, your email address if you opt in to receive results or price alerts, and basic usage data such as pages visited and features used.
privacy.useBody: We use your information to: identify products in your uploaded images and videos, send you search results and price drop alerts if you provide your email, improve our AI product-matching technology, and analyze usage patterns to improve the service.
privacy.sharingBody: We may share limited data with: affiliate retail partners to fulfill product searches, analytics providers to understand usage patterns, and service providers that help us operate Spot This Fit. We do not sell your personal information to third parties.
privacy.cookiesBody: We use cookies to store your language preference and improve your experience. We may also use analytics cookies to understand how visitors interact with our site. You can disable cookies in your browser settings, though some features may not work properly.
privacy.retentionBody: Uploaded images are processed in real-time and are not stored permanently. Email addresses are retained until you unsubscribe. Usage data is retained in anonymized form for analytics purposes.
privacy.rightsBody: You have the right to: request access to or deletion of your personal data, opt out of marketing emails at any time, and request information about how your data is used. To exercise these rights, contact us at sehmim.haque@gmail.com.
privacy.changesBody: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. We will notify you of significant changes by posting a notice on our site.
